| Rule | The block is rejected when |
|---|---|
| `MV-VERSIONING` | A state bucket of a surgery block has no versioning, so a push couldn't be rolled back (audit check S3-VER). |
| `MV-ACCOUNT` | A moved resource's ARN names another account than the destination unit deploys to. |
| `MV-PLAN` | terragrunt plan failed in a unit of the block. The reason has the error. |
| `MV-VERIFY` | The plan of a unit, against the state after the move, would change a moved resource. A surgery block may only leave no-op and read; a native block's destinations may only import and its source may only forget. |
